# shelf

> File uploads and object storage for agents: presigned upload URLs, magic-byte validation, lifecycle hygiene and egress-first cost, as a CLI, an MCP server and skills.

shelf is an agent-native, self-improving employee: a senior storage engineer who has been paged at 2am by a
viral-file egress bill and a stored-XSS CVE in the same week. It mints presigned upload URLs (a size- and
type-bounded POST policy, not a PUT), round-trips files to R2 or S3 with signed-URL access control, validates
uploads by magic bytes, sets the abort-incomplete-multipart rule on day one, and reasons about cost egress-first.
Powered by Energy.

Default stack (traffic-aware, not dogma): Cloudflare R2 by default (zero egress); S3 as the portability contract
and for events, cold data and compliance; AWS SDK v3 presigned POST policy; MinIO as the free local CI target;
rclone for cross-provider work and orphan hunting; tus (tusd v2.10.0+) for resume-across-sleep; Cloudflare Images
or imgproxy for transforms; Upstash or Supabase for upload state, never `new Map()` on serverless.

The creed: don't trust the client (filename, content-type, headers); make things immutable (random keys,
content-hashed URLs); put a CDN in front of every hot byte; store the pointer in the DB and the bytes in object
storage; pick the provider per workload, not per tribe.

Boundaries: DB blobs and transactional storage under 256K belong to acorn; rate limits and the hot-path cache to
echo; "is this user allowed" to badge; product billing to penny; the upload UI to pixel and pebble. shelf owns the
bytes, the pointer pattern and the signed-URL capability.

Run it: `npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/shelf shelf --help` (CLI) and
`npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/shelf shelf-mcp` (MCP server over stdio). Commands: `presign upload|get`, `upload`,
`get`, `validate`, `lifecycle set|orphans`, `cost estimate`, `backend pick`, `migrate plan`, `scan setup`,
`serve-config`, `cors check`, `brain`, `explain`, `eval` (`--json` on data commands). Most work offline at no cost;
`cors check` and the live signed-URL round-trip need `S3_ENDPOINT` or R2 keys. Brain node IDs: `JTBD-*` jobs,
`S1..S20` scenarios (each a golden eval), `P-01..P-42` pitfalls, `O-01..O-28` opinions, `Dispute A..G` open
debates, `V-01..V-18` drift-watch entries.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how any coding agent uses shelf: the CLI command tree, the MCP tools, the boundaries and the hard refusals.
- [README.md](README.md): what shelf is, one-step installs for every coding agent, the quick start and the harness grades.

## Skills

- [skills/presign-upload/SKILL.md](skills/presign-upload/SKILL.md): POST policy over PUT, the exact signed-header set, expiry is a ceiling (O-14, S6, S7).
- [skills/validate-upload/SKILL.md](skills/validate-upload/SKILL.md): magic bytes not headers, resource caps, random keys, refuse SVG (O-02, O-13, S4, S15).
- [skills/set-lifecycle-hygiene/SKILL.md](skills/set-lifecycle-hygiene/SKILL.md): the abort-incomplete-multipart rule, day one, every bucket (O-17, S11).
- [skills/pick-storage-backend/SKILL.md](skills/pick-storage-backend/SKILL.md): a traffic-aware default and the condition that flips it (O-05, Dispute A, S3).
- [skills/safe-serve/SKILL.md](skills/safe-serve/SKILL.md): two-sided headers; change the URL instead of invalidating the CDN (O-11, O-20, S12).

## MCP tools

- [src/mcp/server.ts](src/mcp/server.ts): shelf's own server (stdio, plus a Streamable HTTP path behind `SHELF_MCP_HTTP`) with `presign_upload`, `presign_get`, `validate_file`, `set_lifecycle`, `find_orphans`, `estimate_cost`, `pick_backend`, `explain_pitfall` and `search_brain`.
- [.mcp.json](.mcp.json): the stranger-safe config: shelf's server from GitHub and context7, no secrets.
- [.well-known/agent.json](.well-known/agent.json): the A2A agent card.
